title: Principal SQL Server Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,500 - $7,000 USD


Along with our partner, we’re looking for a Principal Database Engineer who can serve as the technical leader for our SQL Server–focused engineering team. This person should be the team’s strongest expert in SQL Server development, performance engineering, and operational reliability — and equally strong in designing

data‐centric solutions that balance correctness, performance, maintainability, and business constraints.


The ideal candidate brings deep, hands‐on mastery of SQL Server internals and can connect engine

behavior to real‐world workload patterns. They should be able to diagnose, design, enhance, and

optimize database solutions at scale, and guide others in doing the same.


You will collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are

well‐understood, technically feasible, and aligned with long‐term architectural goals.


Essential Duties:

  • Database Design and Development: Guide the evolution and improvement of database architecture, design and implementations. Apply expert‐level understanding of relational modeling, T‐SQL, indexing strategies, and SQL Server engine behavior to build systems that scale and perform under real‐world workloads.
  • Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Continuously assess system performance at both the instance and query level. Diagnose and remediate issues, including those involving poor execution plans, parameter sniffing, bad cardinality estimation, SARGability obstacles, inadequate or incorrect indexing, and concurrency issues involving locking, blocking, and/or deadlocks.
  • Engineering Solution Design: Break down complex data and workload problems, identify multiple viable solution paths, and evaluate them against functional and non‐functional requirements. Clearly articulate tradeoffs, recommend, and justify the best approach.
  • Collaboration with Development Teams: Partner closely with application and service teams to ensure database designs support application behavior, performance goals, and operational constraints. Provide guidance on query patterns, schema usage, and integration with .NET and cloud services.
  • Incident Management: Lead the response to database‐related incidents. Perform root‐cause analysis, implement durable fixes, and improve observability, alerting, and operational readiness.
  • Mentorship and Training: Coach and mentor database engineers and developers. Establish and promote best practices in SQL development, performance tuning, and operational excellence.
  • Data Security Management: Contribute to the implementation and enforcement of security controls, ensuring protection of sensitive data and compliance with relevant standards.
  • Backup, Recovery, and Reliability Engineering: Contribute to the design and management of resilient backup, restore, and disaster‐recovery processes. Help ensure systems are prepared for failure scenarios and can recover predictably.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 10+ years in database engineering, data management, or database administration, with significant hands‐on experience in SQL Server.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Deep expertise in SQL Server development, performance tuning, and engine internals.
  • Strong understanding of indexing, execution plans, statistics, concurrency, and workload behavior.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), including managed SQL services and related data technologies.
  • Proficiency in T‐SQL; familiarity with C#/.NET services is a plus.


Key Competencies:

  • Database Design and Architecture: Ability to design scalable, efficient SQL Server solutions in cloud environments, with strong judgment around schema design, indexing, and workload patterns.
  • Performance Tuning and Optimization: Expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance issues at all layers of the SQL Server stack.
  • Cloud Technologies: Experience with cloud‐based database services (Azure SQL, Managed Instance, AWS RDS, etc.) and understanding of how cloud infrastructure impacts database design and performance.
  • Programming and Engineering Skills: Strong T‐SQL development skills and familiarity with the broader SQL Server ecosystem. Ability to reason about system‐level design and integrate database solutions with application architectures.
  • Data Management and Security: Ensure data integrity, enforce security controls, and resolve data‐related issues with precision and accountability.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and communicate clearly with cross‐functional partners. Influence architectural direction and foster a culture of engineering excellence.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and optimize large-scale data systems that power critical business operations.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Sr Financial Analyst
description:
WHO ARE WE?


Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .


THE JOB


The Senior Finance Analyst plays a key role in consolidating and harmonizing financial and accounting practices across multiple subsidiaries. This position supports the accuracy and integrity of accounting records, ensures compliance with corporate policies, and drives alignment with financial best practices. Partnering closely with subsidiary accounting teams, the Senior Finance Analyst provides guidance, implements standardized processes, and delivers reliable financial insights to support holding-level operations and strategic decision-making.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Manage and oversee accounting processes while supporting subsidiaries, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, accruals, and month-end close activities.
  • Support the consolidation of financial statements and management reporting, improving accuracy, consistency, and transparency across all entities.
  • Act as a liaison between Holding company and subsidiary accounting teams, promoting best practices and ensuring adherence to corporate accounting standards and policies.
  • Monitor holding-level cash flow and working capital, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete financial data from subsidiaries.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to enhance accounting efficiency and accuracy through process standardization, automation, and system improvements.
  • Provide reliable financial and accounting data to Holding leadership to support operational planning, analysis, and strategic decision-making.


WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related field.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in accounting, audit, or corporate finance, preferably within multi-entity, regional, or holding company structures.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles (IFRS/US GAAP), reconciliations, consolidations, and financial reporting.
  • Hands-on experience managing AP/AR processes, month-end close preparation across multiple entities.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluency in English


HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.


Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.


Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

title: Founding Engineer (Path to CTO)
description:
SOBRE A VAGA


A Hamurabi Apps está contratando uma pessoa engenheira, builder, intensa e extremamente dona pra ser nossa CTO fundadora.


A vaga tem um arco claro. Nos primeiros 3-6 meses, você é, na prática, Founding Engineer: codando todos os dias, polindo os 5 produtos até estado lançável, construindo infra compartilhada e operando produto em produção. Conforme a receita aparece e o time cresce, você assume o papel pleno de CTO: contratação, arquitetura, mentoria, direção técnica, e cada vez menos código diário.


Vaga founding, equity-only. Você trabalha direto com o Pablo (founder da Izzicupo Borges, que adquiriu a Hamurabi) e com o Founding Operator, que vamos trazer em paralelo.


SNAPSHOT


• Localização: Remoto Brasil + workshops/sprints ocasionais em Uberlândia/MG (sede da Izzicupo Borges)

• Modelo: equity-only no início, com gatilhos claros de receita destravando comp fixa (detalhe em POTENCIAL DE GANHO)

• Equity: 15% founding-level (vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano, reverse vesting, bad leaver clauses padrão)

• Bônus por milestone de produto: definidos caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários)

• Path to CTO consolidado: Cargo se consolida com 3+ engenheiros sob você e infra em produção com SLA

• Perfil: full-stack sênior ou staff, AI-native, customer-obsessed, confortável codando legal-tech, dev-tools, cloud, ERP e agentes no mesmo mês


O QUE FAZEMOS


A Hamurabi Apps é um estúdio de micro-apps. Nascemos como software house low-code/no-code (Bubble Silver Partner). Em 2025, fomos adquiridos pela Izzicupo Borges e estamos relançando a tese: portfólio focado de produtos com receita recorrente, todos construídos, operados e licenciados sob o mesmo teto, com infra compartilhada e distribuição cruzada. Cinco micro-apps medianos rendendo R$ 30k de MRR cada batem uma startup média lutando por PMF.


Portfólio atual (5 produtos não lançados publicamente):

• Análise de risco jurídico em contratos com NLP, pra escritórios e jurídicos in-house

• Analytics de performance de engenharia com IA, pra times técnicos e CTOs

• Plataforma de automação e infra cloud, pra times que orquestram deploy e workflows

• ERPs sob medida pra PMEs (gestão financeira, fiscal, operacional)

• Agente que constrói landing pages do zero a partir de prompt


NOSSA MISSÃO


Provar que dá pra construir uma fábrica brasileira de software AI-native gerando milhões em ARR com time pequeno, intenso e dono. A maioria dos estúdios brasileiros nasce com cara de incubadora, escritório bonito, demo day e zero produto rodando. A Hamurabi nasce do oposto: produto primeiro, narrativa depois.


COMO É O DIA A DIA


Você não vai herdar uma engenharia rodando, vai construí-la. Não tem head of eng, QA dedicado, DevOps. Tem o Pablo (founder, também codador), o Founding Operator (que vamos trazer em paralelo), 1 dev pleno e os 5 produtos com graus diferentes de maturidade.


A pessoa certa abre issue do produto jurídico às 9h, faz code review do dev pleno às 11h, refatora o RAG do produto de analytics à tarde, sobe deploy do produto de cloud à noite, e no dia seguinte abre PR de uma abstração compartilhada que vai servir o próximo micro-app.


NÃO APLIQUE SE VOCÊ:


• Espera receber arquitetura desenhada e sprint planejado. Aqui você É o arquiteto e o planner

• Precisa de salário fixo grande. A base é zero no início. Dinheiro vem da equity, gatilhos e milestones

• Não codifica em produção há mais de 6 meses. A vaga é hands-on do dia 1

• Tem ego de cargo. Você vai escrever código, fazer deploy, debugar produção, code review, JD, tudo, sozinho, no começo

• Não usa IA pra programar (Cursor, Claude, MCP). Aqui IA escreve a maior parte do boilerplate

• Tem medo de mexer em múltiplas linguagens/stacks ao mesmo tempo (TS, Python, infra, AI, frontend)

• Precisa de processo todo desenhado e backlog todo grooming antes de começar

• Não topa ambiente de altíssima exigência. Acompanhamos ship rate, uptime e qualidade semanalmente desde o dia 1


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


Construir e shippar (responsabilidade #1, sobretudo nos primeiros 3-6 meses):

• Polir os 5 produtos do portfólio até estado lançável (UX, performance, billing, onboarding, observabilidade)

• Codar diariamente em produção. Backend, frontend, infra, AI, integrações: você cobre tudo

• Estabelecer infra compartilhada (billing, auth, observability, analytics) entre os 5 produtos

• Subir o que quebrar, otimizar o que estiver lento, refatorar o que estiver podre


Operar e escalar (escopo cresce a partir do mês 3):

• Uptime, SLAs, segurança, custo de infra, CI/CD, observabilidade, on-call

• Migrar/desmontar o que sobrou de Bubble pra stack code-first quando fizer sentido

• Construir abstrações reutilizáveis pro próximo micro-app entrar com fricção mínima


Construir time e arquitetura (escopo cresce a partir do mês 6):

• Contratar a guilda de founding builders na medida em que a receita destrava

• Formar e mentorar o dev pleno e os juniors que já estão no radar

• Definir padrões de código, arquitetura, testing, code review, documentação

• Trabalhar com o Pablo na visão técnica e com o Founding Operator na priorização de produto


STACK


Code-first, AI-native, enxuto. Stack atual (e onde queremos chegar):

TypeScript (Node.js, NestJS, Next.js, React) · Python (FastAPI, NLP, agentes) · PostgreSQL · vector DBs (Weaviate, ChromaDB) · OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain · AWS, Vercel, Railway, Docker · GitHub Actions · Cursor, Claude e MCP pra programar todo dia · Stripe pra billing · Bubble (legacy, vamos migrar/desmontar conforme fizer sentido).


Você não precisa ter usado tudo. Precisa ser muito confortável aprendendo rápido e operando full-stack de verdade.


QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS


• 5+ anos construindo software em produção, com pelo menos 1 produto B2B sério no histórico

• Domínio de TypeScript + Python (ou conforto absoluto pra ir e vir entre os dois)

• Experiência com banco relacional, APIs, auth, deploy, logs e debugging em produção

• Capacidade de ir do problema de negócio ao código sem travar

• Uso intenso de IA pra programar, pesquisar, documentar, testar, prototipar e automatizar

• Tolerância a risco real: você topa equity-only no início em troca de equity founding-level e cargo de CTO

• Capacidade de fazer deep work técnico E pensamento de arquitetura no mesmo dia, sem confundir os dois


DIFERENCIAIS


• Já ter sido founding engineer ou CTO #1 de startup que atingiu PMF

• Já ter operado portfolio (multi-produto, multi-stack) em estúdio, agência ou holding

• Experiência com IA em produção: prompts, evals, guardrails, latência, custo, RAG, multi-agent

• Experiência com migração/sunset de plataforma low-code (Bubble, Webflow) pra stack code-first

• Já ter contratado, formado e liderado time de 3 a 10 engenheiros

• Vontade real de virar CTO de verdade: visão, hiring, board, captação, demissão


COMO MEDIMOS SUCESSO


Indicadores mudam ao longo da rampa. Ship, depois uptime, depois escala.


• Ship (semanas 1-12): 5 produtos lançáveis, com infra compartilhada de billing/auth/observability operando

• Uptime (mês 4+): SLA em produção, MTTR baixo, incidentes resolvidos com postmortem

• Escala (mês 6+): infra suportando 10x usuários sem refatoração; novo micro-app entra com setup de poucos dias

• Time: cadência de contratação alinhada com receita; mentoria efetiva do dev pleno e juniors

• Ownership: você define meta técnica, executa, comunica risco cedo, entrega sem precisar ser microgerenciado


CULTURA HAMURABI


Não confundimos flexibilidade com baixa intensidade. Não confundimos remoto com folga. Usamos muito IA, mas também esperamos que você saiba o que está acontecendo por baixo: cliente, dor real, produto, número, contrato, relacionamento. A gente não tem fôlego pra carregar quem não está produzindo. Quem performa tem autonomia total, equity founding-level e cargo de CTO crescendo com o estúdio.


• Ownership extremo • Honestidade radical • Entrega acima de discurso • Velocidade com qualidade • Customer love acima de tudo • Multi-produto, multi-stack, multi-chapéu • IA como alavanca diária

• TODO MUNDO DONO (sim, aqui todos os founding members tem equity).


POTENCIAL DE GANHO


Compensação inicial é equity-only de propósito. O upside é o ponto inteiro dessa vaga.


Equity: 15% founding-level, vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano. Em tese realizada (R$ 5M+ de ARR, múltiplos SaaS B2B 5-10x), pode atingir R$ 3,75M-7,5M. Em tese acelerada (R$ 15M+ de ARR), R$ 11M-22M.


Comp. destravada por receita:

• MRR R$ 30k/mês: base R$ 8k/mês PJ (~R$ 96k/ano)

• MRR R$ 80k/mês: base R$ 15k/mês (R$ 180k/ano)

• MRR R$ 200k/mês: base R$ 25k/mês + bônus por milestone


Bônus por milestone: definido caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários).


COMO APLICAR


Lemos toda aplicação séria e damos retorno.


E-mail:

• Para:

• Assunto: Founding CTO - Hamurabi - Aplicacao

• ou GitHub + texto curto se apresentando


Responda também:

• Por que você quer ser CTO da Hamurabi no modelo micro-apps studio?

• Qual o sistema mais difícil que você já colocou em produção? Stack, escala, decisões

• Como você usa IA hoje no seu trabalho de engenharia?

• Olhando os 5 produtos acima, qual você abordaria primeiro tecnicamente, e por quê?

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
Senior Backend Engineer

Hitch — Remote


About Hitch

Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.


We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance.
  • Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job.
  • Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code.
  • Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring.
  • Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews.
  • Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.


What You Bring

  • 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Deep experience with Node.js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior.
  • Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma; you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent).
  • A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation.
  • Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask \"what happens if this fails halfway through?\"
  • Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns.
  • Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical.
  • Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms.
  • Familiarity with Next.js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role).
  • Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.

    • Our Backend Stack

    TypeScript · Node.js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.

  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.

Soft Skills

Preferred

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.

title: FX Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Freight Hero

FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.


We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.


The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.


About the Role

This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.


What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.
  • Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient.
  • Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:


Full Stack Engineering

  • Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.
  • Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.


AWS native Architecture

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.


Systems Integration

  • Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.


AI Forward Development

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.


Collaboration & Impact

  • Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.


What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.
  • Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation.
  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).
  • Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams.
  • High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work.
  • Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.


Why Freight Hero

  • Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech.
  • Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes.
  • Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales.
  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to support enterprise infrastructure automation and CI/CD modernization initiatives. This role will play a critical part in a large-scale migration to Harness, making hands-on Harness experience mandatory. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices. This engineer will work closely with development, operations, and security teams to streamline deployments, improve reliability, and enhance operational efficiency across enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities:

CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Harness, Jenkins, and other automation tools.
  • Lead and support migration efforts from legacy deployment tools and pipelines into Harness.
  • Implement deployment automation strategies to improve release speed, consistency, and reliability.Manage Git-based workflows and support DevOps best practices across engineering teams.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and related tools.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support cloud environments including AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, and high availability across environments.

Containerization & Platform Engineering

  • Deploy and support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Support platform modernization and enterprise DevOps transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system architecture and deployment standards.

Monitoring, Security & Operational Support

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and uptime.
  • Support DevSecOps initiatives including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance automation.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, deployments, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA, and security teams to align DevOps strategies and standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on DevOps best practices.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with Harness implementation and administration.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong expertise with Terraform, Jenkins, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or Groovy.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitOps workflows and version control best practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps concepts and secure deployment practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins or other legacy platforms into Harness.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate, or Harness certifications are a plus.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
Senior Backend Engineer

Hitch — Remote


About Hitch

Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.


We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance.
  • Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job.
  • Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code.
  • Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring.
  • Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews.
  • Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.


What You Bring

  • 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Deep experience with Node.js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior.
  • Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma; you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent).
  • A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation.
  • Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask \"what happens if this fails halfway through?\"
  • Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns.
  • Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical.
  • Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms.
  • Familiarity with Next.js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role).

title: Enterprise IS Security Engineer
description:
Enterprise IS Security Engineer


About Pyxus


We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve.

As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. Our culture is built on resilience, accountability, encouragement, and transparency, and we value each team member for their experience, knowledge, and passion.

Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together!


Job Scope

The Enterprise Security Engineer will join our growing security team. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining security measures to protect our systems, network, and data from cyber threats. You will play a critical role in identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

This is a fully remote position. The role focuses on supporting our U.S. Corporate unit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Implement, manage and monitor M365 and Cloud services security tools and controls.
  • Implement, manage and monitor appropriate identity and access management tools and controls.
  • Implement, manage, and monitor security measures that support Zero Trust Architecture.
  • Implement, manage and monitor Endpoint Security systems (application whitelisting, device control, Anti-Virus, encryption).
  • Create, maintain and implement Active directory Group Policy Objects related to cybersecurity.
  • Manage patch rollout processes and network vulnerability remediation
  • Administer security awareness training platforms and promote cybersecurity best practices
  • Manage password management tools and internal/external certificate infrastructure
  • Design and implement enhanced Domain Security structures
  • Maintain and enhance cybersecurity frameworks, plans, and IS documentation
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, IS policies, and best practices
  • Implement, manage, and monitor enterprise IDS/IPS and DLP systems
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and oversee remediation activities
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure application security and provide IS security guidance for projects and policies
  • Monitor emerging threats (Microsoft, Cisco, CERT, SANS), support incident response and forensic investigations, contribute to C-level updates, and provide 24x7 on-call support


Qualifications

  • Fluent English
  • Four-year Degree in Information Technology or Business related field.
  • Certification in industry recognized cybersecurity qualifications (e.g. CompTIA Security+, CISSP)
  • Experience in Cybersecurity.
  • Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, Active Directory, IP Address Management
  • Working knowledge of Firewalls (ISA, CISCO ASA, Palo Alto)
  • Experience with Endpoint Security and SIEM systems.
  • Experience with Infrastructure related Security tools and procedures – perimeter and internal.
  • Experience with securing Cloud based workloads, services and resources.
  • Strong Knowledge of encryption and certificate infrastructure.
  • Project Management Experience beneficial.
  • Experience in Cloud Architecture and design in a multi-forest and domain environment.
  • Knowledge and experience in Windows Server OS and hardware.
  • Excellent Oral and Written Communication skills.
  • Excellent Documentation skills.
  • Consistency and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work well with others while maintaining a high degree of confidentiality, honesty and integrity.
  • Able to do international and/or domestic travel as required.

This includes Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Race, Ethnicity, and Religion.

description:

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Precisamos de um(a) Data Engineer para atuar no time de Finance Transformation , apoiando iniciativas de dados relacionadas a processos financeiros, com foco em billing, faturamento, faturas, cobranças, conciliação e indicadores financeiros .

A pessoa deverá atuar na construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados em ambiente Databricks/Lakehouse , garantindo ingestão, transformação, qualidade e disponibilização dos dados para consumo analítico e camada semântica. Também deverá apoiar a preparação de bases e datasets para consumo em Power BI .


Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e hands-on, com boa comunicação para interagir com times de negócio e tecnologia. É importante que tenha visão ponta a ponta dos dados, capacidade de entender regras financeiras e transformá-las em pipelines, modelos e indicadores confiáveis.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

• Desenvolver pipelines de ingestão, tratamento e transformação de dados usando Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Trabalhar com dados de billing, faturas, transações, cobranças, pagamentos, ajustes, estornos e conciliações.

• Garantir consistência dos dados entre camadas de ingestão, preparação, refinamento e consumo.

• Apoiar a criação de datasets, modelos analíticos e indicadores para Power BI.

• Implementar validações de qualidade, reconciliação e rastreabilidade dos dados.

• Documentar fluxos, regras de transformação, dicionário de dados e mapeamentos.

• Interagir com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e finanças.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida como Data Engineer.

• Experiência prática com Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lake/Lakehouse.

• Experiência com Power BI, especialmente preparação de datasets/modelos para consumo analítico.

• Conhecimento de processos financeiros: billing, faturamento, cobrança, contas a receber, conciliação ou pagamentos.

• Experiência com cloud, preferencialmente Azure.

• Conhecimento de governança, qualidade, linhagem e documentação de dados.


Diferenciais

• Experiência em bancos, meios de pagamento, adquirência, fintechs ou ambientes regulados.

• Conhecimento em camada semântica, produtos de dados ou governança corporativa.

• Experiência com Jira, Confluence, Azure Data Factory, Purview ou OpenMetadata.

title: Live Support Representative
description:
Live Support Representative


Xenia Platform | Remote — Brazil | Full-Time

Department

Customer Success

Location

Remote — Brazil

Employment Type

Full-Time

Language Requirement

English — Fluent (spoken & written)

Working Hours

US business hours overlap required (CST preferred)


About Xenia


Xenia is a frontline operations platform built for multi-unit operators across restaurants, retail, convenience stores, hotels, and hospitality. We help operations teams manage tasks, checklists, inspections, work orders, and team communications — all in one place. Our customers run lean teams across dozens or hundreds of locations, and they rely on Xenia to keep their operations consistent and compliant every day.


We're a Series A-stage company with a growing customer base across the United States. Our team is small, scrappy, and serious about delivering a best-in-class experience to the frontline operators who trust us.


The Role


We are hiring a Live Support Representative to serve as the dedicated live support contact for Xenia customers — handling support over Zoom and Google Meet, not just email or chat queues.


This role exists to own the customer-facing support experience end-to-end: meeting with customers directly over video, troubleshooting issues in real time, answering product questions, and coordinating with our internal QA and engineering teams to ensure bugs get resolved and customers hear back with a clear answer.


Today, this burden falls on our Implementation and Customer Success teams — slowing down onboarding and strategic account work. Your job is to take that entirely off their plate. You will be the first point of escalation for customers who need live support, whether they are three weeks into implementation or two years post-launch.


What You'll Do

  • Own the live support channel — host Zoom and Google Meet sessions with US-based customers to troubleshoot issues, answer product questions, and resolve blockers in real time.
  • Support customers at every stage — whether they are mid-implementation, newly live, or long-tenured accounts, you provide consistent, knowledgeable support.
  • Triage and document issues — clearly document bugs, unexpected behaviors, and feature questions; distinguish between user error, configuration issues, and genuine software bugs.
  • Coordinate with QA and Engineering — file detailed bug reports, track issues through resolution, and proactively circle back with the customer once fixes are deployed.
  • Maintain a customer-facing communication style throughout — you represent Xenia professionally on camera with US customers and set the bar for clarity and calm under pressure.
  • Manage your own queue — track open support items, follow up without being asked, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Collaborate with Implementation and CS teams — hand off relevant context when issues touch onboarding workflows or account health, but take full ownership of the support resolution itself.
  • Contribute to our support knowledge base — document common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps so the team improves over time.


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 2+ years of B2B SaaS customer support experience — you have worked directly with business customers, not just end consumers.
  • Experience conducting live support over video (Zoom, Google Meet, or equivalent) — you are comfortable on camera and can lead a call with a customer you've never met.
  • Fluent English — spoken and written. You will be speaking with US-based operations teams, managers, and occasionally executives on camera. Clear, professional, confident communication is non-negotiable.
  • Ability to work US business hours — specifically Central or Eastern time overlap (9am–6pm CST).
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts — you can systematically work through a problem, isolate the issue, and explain what you found in plain language.
  • Organized and self-directed — you manage your own follow-ups, track open items, and close the loop without needing reminders.
  • Professional on-camera presence — reliable internet, clean background or virtual background, quality audio, and a professional demeanor during customer calls.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with operations, hospitality, restaurant, retail, or convenience store software.
  • Familiarity with feature request/issue tracking tools (Jira, Linear, or similar).
  • Experience working with a QA or engineering team to report and track issues.
  • Prior experience supporting customers in a US SaaS company from a remote/international location.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you have completed onboarding, shadowed existing support calls, and are independently running customer support sessions with light oversight.


By 60 days, you own the live support queue end-to-end — customers are getting timely responses, meetings are being booked and run efficiently, and bugs are being documented and tracked to resolution.


By 90 days, Implementation and CS are no longer fielding reactive support calls. They're focused on implementation and account growth. You are the reason why.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote position — work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct exposure to a US-based growth-stage SaaS company and its customers.
  • A small, high-trust team where your work is visible and your impact is real.
  • Opportunity to grow as Xenia scales — this role is foundational to how we build our support function.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Senior Operations Manager (Liza Edtech)

  • Salary: R$10.000,00 - R$20.000,00
  • Location: 100% remote work. Possibility of in-person work in São Paulo in the future.
  • Type: Full-time


Who We Are & Our Story


Liza is a pioneering EdTech that uses Artificial Intelligence to transform pedagogical management and give time back to educators. Our company combines the operational rigor of the largest educational networks with innovation from Stanford.

  • Lisa Zhang (Founder): Experienced international founder, headquartered in Silicon Valley.
  • Fernando Cofiel (COO): Former COO of Maple Bear for 9 years, with extensive experience in operations scaling and franchising.

We were born to give time back to teachers and deliver data intelligence to public and private administrators.


Who We’re Looking For


We are looking for a high-energy, execution-driven Operations Manager to help us build and scale our company. Someone with a strong startup mindset: fast-moving, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable solving problems in a dynamic environment. This person will work closely with leadership to manage projects, follow up on team execution, improve internal processes, and make sure work is delivered with speed, quality, and accountability.


What You’ll Do


As Senior Operations Manager, you will help keep the company running smoothly and make sure important projects move forward.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing internal projects from planning to execution
  • Following up with team members on task delivery and deadlines
  • Creating clear workflows, processes, and systems
  • Helping leadership track priorities, problems, and next steps
  • Identifying operational bottlenecks and solving them quickly
  • Supporting cross-functional work between sales, product, customer success, and leadership
  • Maintaining a high standard of execution across the team
  • Helping the company operate with more speed, structure, and accountability


The Person We Need


  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Fast-paced, proactive, and execution-focused
  • A quick learner who can adapt quickly
  • Strong at problem-solving and follow-through
  • Comfortable working under pressure
  • Good at project management and team coordination
  • Able to hold themselves and others to high standards
  • Energetic, positive, and easy to work with
  • Comfortable in a startup environment with changing priorities
  • Responsible, reliable, and ownership-driven


Ideal background


  • Experience working in a startup or fast-growing company
  • Experience in operations, project management, business operations, or executive support
  • Experience working with leadership teams or founders
  • Exposure to larger companies or more structured organizations is a plus
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work remotely with discipline and independence
  • Portuguese fluency required
  • English proficiency is a strong plus


Why join HiLiza


HiLiza is building an AI-native education platform designed to support public school systems, teachers, coordinators, and education leaders. This is an opportunity to join an early-stage company with strong growth potential and help build the operational foundation of the business from the ground up.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to be close to leadership, work on important company priorities, and grow with a startup.


How to apply


Please send your resume and a short message explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Include examples of projects, teams, or operations work you have managed before.
