title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira.

Se é você, adoraríamos conversar.


Sobre o papel

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Asset Integrity sênior com sólida experiência em O&G offshore para desenvolver e gerenciar programas de Asset Integrity Management (AIM), conduzir estudos de RBI (Risk-Based Inspection) e executar inspeções de integridade de equipamentos, dutos e tanques em conformidade com normas API, ASME e regulações ANP. O candidato ideal deve possuir CREA ativo, domínio profundo de metodologias de inspeção e Fitness-for-Service (FFS), fluência em inglês avançado e capacidade de gerenciar interfaces multidisciplinares com clientes operadores e órgãos reguladores, com perfil de Seller-Doer em desenvolvimento combinando expertise técnica em integridade de equipamentos com progressivo envolvimento comercial em propostas técnicas e suporte ao ciclo de vendas da BV.


Sobre o Grupo Bureau Veritas

Fundado em 1828, somos líder mundial em serviços de testes laboratoriais, inspeção e certificação, possuímos mais de 74 mil funcionários em 1.400 escritórios e laboratórios ao redor do globo. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social. Há 190 anos nossa marca é sinônimo de integridade e confiança, em benefício dos negócios e das pessoas, contribuindo para transformar o mundo em que vivemos. Para saber um pouco mais acesse o site


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e gerenciar programas de Asset Integrity Management (AIM)
  • Conduzir estudos de RBI (Risk-Based Inspection)
  • Executar e supervisionar inspeções de integridade de dutos e tubulações
  • Gerenciar inspeções de tanques de armazenamento
  • Elaborar estudos de Fitness-for-Service (FFS)
  • Desenvolver programas de gestão de corrosão
  • Apoiar a estruturação de propostas técnicas e comerciais
  • Atuar como interface técnica com ANP, clientes e rede global BV
  • Contribuir ao ciclo de vendas


O que buscamos:

  • Engenharia Mecânica, de Materiais, Química ou correlata — CREA ativo obrigatório
  • Experiência em Asset Integrity / Inspeção de Equipamentos, com atuação em O&G offshore
  • API 580/581 (RBI), API 570, API 653, API 579 (FFS), ASME B31.3/B31.4/B31.8
  • Familiaridade com MFL, ACFM, TOFD, Phased Array, Laser Scan, Drone Inspection
  • Experiência ou exposição a plataformas de Digital Twin para gestão de ativos
  • NR-13 (vasos, caldeiras, tubulações), resoluções ANP para integridade de instalações offshore
  • API 571, API 577, ASNT Level II/III, CSWIP ou equivalentes;
  • Inglês avançado obrigatório, interlocução técnica com rede global BV e clientes internacionais
  • Especialização em Integridade de Equipamentos, Engenharia de Confiabilidade ou correlata — diferencial


O que nós podemos oferecer:

Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, trabalhando em uma equipe de especialistas. Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios.

Ao participar deste processo de recrutamento & seleção, do Bureau Veritas Brasil, o(a) candidato(a) declara:

  • Estar em condições técnicas e operacionais, no que tange à ergonomia, estação de trabalho e velocidade de conexão internet para desempenhar, quando necessário, o trabalho remoto “home office”;
  • O Bureau Veritas está em conformidade com a Constituição Federal brasileira (no inc. V do seu art. 5o.inc. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: Live Support Representative
description:
Live Support Representative


Xenia Platform | Remote — Brazil | Full-Time

Department

Customer Success

Location

Remote — Brazil

Employment Type

Full-Time

Language Requirement

English — Fluent (spoken & written)

Working Hours

US business hours overlap required (CST preferred)


About Xenia


Xenia is a frontline operations platform built for multi-unit operators across restaurants, retail, convenience stores, hotels, and hospitality. We help operations teams manage tasks, checklists, inspections, work orders, and team communications — all in one place. Our customers run lean teams across dozens or hundreds of locations, and they rely on Xenia to keep their operations consistent and compliant every day.


We're a Series A-stage company with a growing customer base across the United States. Our team is small, scrappy, and serious about delivering a best-in-class experience to the frontline operators who trust us.


The Role


We are hiring a Live Support Representative to serve as the dedicated live support contact for Xenia customers — handling support over Zoom and Google Meet, not just email or chat queues.


This role exists to own the customer-facing support experience end-to-end: meeting with customers directly over video, troubleshooting issues in real time, answering product questions, and coordinating with our internal QA and engineering teams to ensure bugs get resolved and customers hear back with a clear answer.


Today, this burden falls on our Implementation and Customer Success teams — slowing down onboarding and strategic account work. Your job is to take that entirely off their plate. You will be the first point of escalation for customers who need live support, whether they are three weeks into implementation or two years post-launch.


What You'll Do

  • Own the live support channel — host Zoom and Google Meet sessions with US-based customers to troubleshoot issues, answer product questions, and resolve blockers in real time.
  • Support customers at every stage — whether they are mid-implementation, newly live, or long-tenured accounts, you provide consistent, knowledgeable support.
  • Triage and document issues — clearly document bugs, unexpected behaviors, and feature questions; distinguish between user error, configuration issues, and genuine software bugs.
  • Coordinate with QA and Engineering — file detailed bug reports, track issues through resolution, and proactively circle back with the customer once fixes are deployed.
  • Maintain a customer-facing communication style throughout — you represent Xenia professionally on camera with US customers and set the bar for clarity and calm under pressure.
  • Manage your own queue — track open support items, follow up without being asked, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Collaborate with Implementation and CS teams — hand off relevant context when issues touch onboarding workflows or account health, but take full ownership of the support resolution itself.
  • Contribute to our support knowledge base — document common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps so the team improves over time.


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 2+ years of B2B SaaS customer support experience — you have worked directly with business customers, not just end consumers.
  • Experience conducting live support over video (Zoom, Google Meet, or equivalent) — you are comfortable on camera and can lead a call with a customer you've never met.
  • Fluent English — spoken and written. You will be speaking with US-based operations teams, managers, and occasionally executives on camera. Clear, professional, confident communication is non-negotiable.
  • Ability to work US business hours — specifically Central or Eastern time overlap (9am–6pm CST).
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts — you can systematically work through a problem, isolate the issue, and explain what you found in plain language.
  • Organized and self-directed — you manage your own follow-ups, track open items, and close the loop without needing reminders.
  • Professional on-camera presence — reliable internet, clean background or virtual background, quality audio, and a professional demeanor during customer calls.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with operations, hospitality, restaurant, retail, or convenience store software.
  • Familiarity with feature request/issue tracking tools (Jira, Linear, or similar).
  • Experience working with a QA or engineering team to report and track issues.
  • Prior experience supporting customers in a US SaaS company from a remote/international location.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you have completed onboarding, shadowed existing support calls, and are independently running customer support sessions with light oversight.


By 60 days, you own the live support queue end-to-end — customers are getting timely responses, meetings are being booked and run efficiently, and bugs are being documented and tracked to resolution.


By 90 days, Implementation and CS are no longer fielding reactive support calls. They're focused on implementation and account growth. You are the reason why.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote position — work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct exposure to a US-based growth-stage SaaS company and its customers.
  • A small, high-trust team where your work is visible and your impact is real.
  • Opportunity to grow as Xenia scales — this role is foundational to how we build our support function.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
Charly Agency is a globally operating boutique digital agency based in Barcelona, Spain. With a highly skilled and agile team, we specialize in crafting high-quality websites with a strong focus on content marketing, UX, and design — helping businesses succeed in the digital space. Our clients range from startups and SMBs to corporate entities, covering industries such as NGOs, B2B, and eCommerce. We primarily work with Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, and Framer.


With a client base predominantly in the USA, Charly Agency is recognized for its expertise in creating high-converting, future-proof websites, apps, and brand assets.


Our core services include:


  • Web design & UX/UI
  • Web and mobile app development
  • Brand strategy
  • eCommerce solutions and CRO
  • Website development and maintenance
  • SEO & Content writing


We're Hirieng: CRO Specialist


We’re looking for someone who understands user behavior, conversion psychology, and how to turn websites and funnels into measurable business growth.

This is a highly execution-focused role centered around CRO strategy, funnel analysis, UX improvements, experimentation, and performance optimization across both eCommerce and B2B websites.


What you'll do


  • CRO Audits – Conducting conversion rate optimization audits for both DTC and B2B businesses, identifying friction points and opportunities across the funnel;
  • Ecommerce Performance Analysis – Analyzing key metrics, diagnosing underperforming areas, and building structured plans to improve results through A/B testing;
  • Landing Page Strategy & Wireframing – Designing landing page structures with a conversion-first mindset, applying UX and copywriting best practices before any design work begins
  • Loom audits – Recording high-level video audits for potential leads, highlighting quick wins and CRO opportunities tailored to their specific site or funnel;
  • Heatmap & Session Recording Analysis – Using tools like Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and identify drop-off patterns;
  • Funnel Mapping – Identifying where users disengage across the customer journey and prioritizing areas for improvement;
  • Copy Review & Optimization – Evaluating and improving headlines, CTAs, and value propositions to increase relevance and conversions;
  • UX & Friction Analysis – Assessing forms, checkout flows, and navigation to remove barriers to conversion;
  • Competitor Analysis – Benchmarking conversion strategies against competitors to identify gaps and opportunities;
  • Post-Purchase Flow Optimization – Improving upsell, cross-sell, and retention sequences after the initial conversion;
  • Reporting – Tracking KPIs and presenting insights;
  • Cross-functional Collaboration – Working with design and development teams to brief, implement, and QA tests and site changes.


What we're looking for


  • Strong understanding of CRO, UX, and user behavior;
  • Experience working with eCommerce and/or B2B websites;
  • Ability to analyze funnels, session recordings, heatmaps, and conversion data;
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution;
  • Clear communication and presentation skills;
  • Experience creating landing page structures and optimization recommendations;
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong analytical thinking;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.


How we work


  • Remote (EU + Americas);
  • Small team, high ownership;
  • Fast-moving environment focused on quality and measurable impact.


To apply


  • Examples of CRO audits, funnels, or websites you’ve optimized;
  • Landing pages or wireframes you’ve contributed to;
  • Case studies or measurable performance improvements;
  • Short video introduction explaining your experience and approach to CRO.

title: Enterprise IS Security Engineer
description:
Enterprise IS Security Engineer


About Pyxus


We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve.

As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. Our culture is built on resilience, accountability, encouragement, and transparency, and we value each team member for their experience, knowledge, and passion.

Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together!


Job Scope

The Enterprise Security Engineer will join our growing security team. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining security measures to protect our systems, network, and data from cyber threats. You will play a critical role in identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

This is a fully remote position. The role focuses on supporting our U.S. Corporate unit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Implement, manage and monitor M365 and Cloud services security tools and controls.
  • Implement, manage and monitor appropriate identity and access management tools and controls.
  • Implement, manage, and monitor security measures that support Zero Trust Architecture.
  • Implement, manage and monitor Endpoint Security systems (application whitelisting, device control, Anti-Virus, encryption).
  • Create, maintain and implement Active directory Group Policy Objects related to cybersecurity.
  • Manage patch rollout processes and network vulnerability remediation
  • Administer security awareness training platforms and promote cybersecurity best practices
  • Manage password management tools and internal/external certificate infrastructure
  • Design and implement enhanced Domain Security structures
  • Maintain and enhance cybersecurity frameworks, plans, and IS documentation
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, IS policies, and best practices
  • Implement, manage, and monitor enterprise IDS/IPS and DLP systems
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and oversee remediation activities
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure application security and provide IS security guidance for projects and policies
  • Monitor emerging threats (Microsoft, Cisco, CERT, SANS), support incident response and forensic investigations, contribute to C-level updates, and provide 24x7 on-call support


Qualifications

  • Fluent English
  • Four-year Degree in Information Technology or Business related field.
  • Certification in industry recognized cybersecurity qualifications (e.g. CompTIA Security+, CISSP)
  • Experience in Cybersecurity.
  • Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, Active Directory, IP Address Management
  • Working knowledge of Firewalls (ISA, CISCO ASA, Palo Alto)
  • Experience with Endpoint Security and SIEM systems.
  • Experience with Infrastructure related Security tools and procedures – perimeter and internal.
  • Experience with securing Cloud based workloads, services and resources.
  • Strong Knowledge of encryption and certificate infrastructure.
  • Project Management Experience beneficial.
  • Experience in Cloud Architecture and design in a multi-forest and domain environment.
  • Knowledge and experience in Windows Server OS and hardware.
  • Excellent Oral and Written Communication skills.
  • Excellent Documentation skills.
  • Consistency and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work well with others while maintaining a high degree of confidentiality, honesty and integrity.
  • Able to do international and/or domestic travel as required.


Benefits

Profit-Sharing Program (PPR)

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Meal Card

Employee Assistance Program – Mental Health and Well-being

Corporate Time Off Days

Wellhub

Group Life Insurance


Applications are open until May 28, 2026.


All opportunities offered by Alliance One consider candidates’ alignment with our STAR values (Supportive, Transparent, Adaptable, and Responsible), in addition to fostering an inclusive culture committed to social responsibility and equity. This includes Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Race, Ethnicity, and Religion.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.

  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.

Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.

  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:

Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.

We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend

  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Freight Hero

FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.


We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.


The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.


About the Role

This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.


What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.
  • Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient.
  • Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:


Full Stack Engineering

  • Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.
  • Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.


AWS native Architecture

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.


Systems Integration

  • Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.


AI Forward Development

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.


Collaboration & Impact

  • Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.


What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.
  • Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation.
  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).
  • Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams.
  • High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work.
  • Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.


Why Freight Hero

  • Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech.
  • Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes.
  • Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales.
  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend

How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: CRO Specialist
description:
Charly Agency is a globally operating boutique digital agency based in Barcelona, Spain. With a highly skilled and agile team, we specialize in crafting high-quality websites with a strong focus on content marketing, UX, and design — helping businesses succeed in the digital space. Our clients range from startups and SMBs to corporate entities, covering industries such as NGOs, B2B, and eCommerce. We primarily work with Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, and Framer.


With a client base predominantly in the USA, Charly Agency is recognized for its expertise in creating high-converting, future-proof websites, apps, and brand assets.

  • Web design & UX/UI
  • Web and mobile app development
  • Brand strategy
  • eCommerce solutions and CRO
  • Website development and maintenance
  • SEO & Content writing


We're Hirieng: CRO Specialist


We’re looking for someone who understands user behavior, conversion psychology, and how to turn websites and funnels into measurable business growth.

This is a highly execution-focused role centered around CRO strategy, funnel analysis, UX improvements, experimentation, and performance optimization across both eCommerce and B2B websites.


What you'll do


  • CRO Audits – Conducting conversion rate optimization audits for both DTC and B2B businesses, identifying friction points and opportunities across the funnel;
  • Ecommerce Performance Analysis – Analyzing key metrics, diagnosing underperforming areas, and building structured plans to improve results through A/B testing;
  • Landing Page Strategy & Wireframing – Designing landing page structures with a conversion-first mindset, applying UX and copywriting best practices before any design work begins
  • Loom audits – Recording high-level video audits for potential leads, highlighting quick wins and CRO opportunities tailored to their specific site or funnel;
  • Heatmap & Session Recording Analysis – Using tools like Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and identify drop-off patterns;
  • Funnel Mapping – Identifying where users disengage across the customer journey and prioritizing areas for improvement;
  • Copy Review & Optimization – Evaluating and improving headlines, CTAs, and value propositions to increase relevance and conversions;
  • UX & Friction Analysis – Assessing forms, checkout flows, and navigation to remove barriers to conversion;
  • Competitor Analysis – Benchmarking conversion strategies against competitors to identify gaps and opportunities;
  • Post-Purchase Flow Optimization – Improving upsell, cross-sell, and retention sequences after the initial conversion;
  • Reporting – Tracking KPIs and presenting insights;
  • Cross-functional Collaboration – Working with design and development teams to brief, implement, and QA tests and site changes.


What we're looking for


  • Strong understanding of CRO, UX, and user behavior;
  • Experience working with eCommerce and/or B2B websites;
  • Ability to analyze funnels, session recordings, heatmaps, and conversion data;
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution;
  • Clear communication and presentation skills;
  • Experience creating landing page structures and optimization recommendations;
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong analytical thinking;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.


How we work


  • Remote (EU + Americas);
  • Small team, high ownership;
  • Fast-moving environment focused on quality and measurable impact.


To apply


  • Examples of CRO audits, funnels, or websites you’ve optimized;
  • Landing pages or wireframes you’ve contributed to;
  • Case studies or measurable performance improvements;
  • Short video introduction explaining your experience and approach to CRO.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer:


We are looking for a full-time, remote DevOps Engineer with 3 to 5 years of work experience to work with our U.S. client. You will collaborate with the Head of DevOps and other technical leaders to build and maintain infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and security processes. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting ISO 27001 / ISMS / SOC2 Type II compliance efforts.


This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. While an infrastructure background is beneficial, you should also be comfortable writing scripts and basic software code to enhance and streamline operations.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the Head of DevOps to define detailed technical requirements, plan work, and prioritize tasks according to business needs
  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS cloud platform solutions

  • Drive automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and system reliability
  • Strive for zero downtime when deploying solutions or services
  • Develop and own scalable processes for: Capacity planning, Configuration management, Monitoring, and observability
  • Provide day-to-day operational support and perform systems administration tasks
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support the platform 24/7
  • Ensure high-quality monitoring coverage for infrastructure and applications
  • Identify potential failure points in infrastructure and proactively develop mitigation strategies
  • Collaborate with internal IT teams for operational support
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type II security frameworks


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 3 to 5 years of DevOps experience
  • Strong AWS experience in infrastructure, security, and automation
  • Technical infrastructure knowledge across servers, storage, and networks
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman, etc.)

  • Comfortable working in high-security and high-compliance environments
  • Hands-on experience scripting and coding for DevOps automation
  • Experience in database administration, performance tuning, and resilience design

  • Strong networking fundamentals (IP, traffic flow, network ports, protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, FTP)

Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related fields

  • Experience with automated testing in DevOps workflows
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), shift-left principles, and immutable infrastructure
  • Experience working in ISO 27001, PCI compliance, or SOC2 Type II environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida como Data Engineer.

• Experiência prática com Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lake/Lakehouse.

• Experiência com Power BI, especialmente preparação de datasets/modelos para consumo analítico.

A Monoda Consulting Group é uma consultoria boutique especializada em Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Analytics e Transformação Digital, atuando de forma integrada em áreas como Finanças, Operações, Vendas e Supply Chain. Desenvolvemos projetos estratégicos e de alto impacto para grandes empresas, conectando tecnologia, negócio e geração de valor real.

Estamos vivendo um momento de forte expansão e crescimento acelerado, buscando profissionais com perfil analítico, empreendedor e ambição de crescimento para construir conosco uma empresa inovadora, dinâmica e com grande potencial de desenvolvimento profissional.


Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um Consultor de Negócios para integrar nossa equipe no Rio de Janeiro, RJ. Este profissional será responsável por identificar desafios empresariais, elaborar estratégias e propor soluções para otimizar processos e gerar valor para nossos clientes. As atividades incluem análise de dados, desenvolvimento de relatórios técnico e financeiro, elaboração de planos de negócios e consultoria estratégica. Este é um cargo de tempo integral em formato híbrido, permitindo trabalho presencial e remoto, com potencial de viagens nacionais e internacionais.


Qualificações

  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar dados complexos, interpretar métricas de negócios de forma crítica e desenvolver soluções baseadas em análise quantitativa e qualitativa.
  • Consultoria: Experiência em consultoria e habilidade para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos organizacionais e estratégias empresariais suportado por inteligência artificial (IA).
  • Consultoria de Gestão: Conhecimento em práticas de gestão e experiência em auxiliar empresas na definição de metas e no alcance de resultados financeiros.
  • Comunicação: Fortes habilidades de comunicação para transmitir recomendações de forma clara e eficiente, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito.
  • Finanças: Entendimento de princípios financeiros e sua aplicação em análise de desempenho organizacional e planejamento estratégico.
  • Formação em Engenharia, fluência em inglês e experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos. Pós graduação será considerado um diferencial, assim como conhecimento em Supply Chain ou O&M (Operação e Manutenção).

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Director of Engineering (LATAM Based) - Remote - $175K Base


About the Company:


We are partnering with a fast-growing SaaS platform modernizing complex operational workflows for institutional financial services organizations. Their technology helps enterprise clients streamline onboarding, transaction management, compliance workflows, and stakeholder collaboration through a secure cloud-based platform.


The product is used by sophisticated organizations that require reliability, scalability, and high standards for security and operational excellence. They are focused on reducing operational friction and delivering a seamless digital experience in an industry traditionally dependent on manual processes.


The Opportunity:


We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead and scale a distributed engineering organization in a high-growth remote environment.


This role will oversee multiple engineering teams and front-line engineering managers across a globally distributed organization. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who excels at building engineering culture, improving operational maturity, and helping teams execute effectively at scale.


You will work closely with executive leadership, product management, and architecture leadership to drive engineering execution, organizational development, and technical excellence.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders across multiple teams
  • Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement
  • Scale engineering operations through effective hiring, onboarding, organizational planning, and career development
  • Improve engineering processes, delivery predictability, and development workflows across teams
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional leadership to align technical execution with business priorities
  • Establish engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and platform reliability
  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones
  • Help create a high-performing, inclusive, and transparent remote-first environment


Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD
  • Fully remote - company HQ'd in the US
  • Opportunity to help shape engineering strategy during a high-growth phase

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

  • You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one
  • Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale
  • Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)
  • The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally
  • Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:
    • Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)
  • Own cross-border legal strategy and execution
  • Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)
  • Work closely with tax advisors
  • Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets
  • Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement
  • Support investor relations from a legal standpoint
  • Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)
  • 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors
  • Proven experience in:
    • Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle
    • Due diligence (legal & regulatory)
    • Complex contract structuring and negotiation
    • International contracts and cross-border operations
  • Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)
  • Solid experience with:
    • Corporate law and governance
    • Investor relations and strategic partnerships
  • Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments

Key Qualities

  • Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth
  • Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions
  • Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks
  • Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed
  • High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure
  • Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally
  • Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains
  • Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets
  • Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms
  • Exposure to governance and international structures
  • Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)
  • Business and legal experience in Germany
  • Speaks German
  • Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Equity to feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: SUPERVISOR DE LIMPEZA - CENTRO/RJ
description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a Vaga: Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Limpeza dinâmico e proativo para liderar nossas equipes operacionais. Nesta função, você será o elo fundamental entre a estratégia da empresa e a execução impecável no cliente. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Supervisionar e orientar as equipes de limpeza e conservação em diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos cronogramas de trabalho e os padrões de qualidade GSS.
  • Realizar a gestão de insumos, controlando a utilização de materiais e equipamentos.
  • Treinar e desenvolver os colaboradores, focando em técnicas eficientes e segurança do trabalho.
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais e manter o contato direto com os clientes para garantir a satisfação total com os serviços prestados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários para otimizar a performance da equipe.

Sobre a Empresa: Fundada em 2007, a GSS Segurança e Serviços consolidou-se como uma das referências no setor de segurança patrimonial e facilities no Brasil. Com sede em São Paulo e filial no Rio de Janeiro, nossa história é pautada pela entrega de soluções personalizadas e eficazes que trazem tranquilidade e proteção ao patrimônio de nossos clientes.

Atuamos com uma metodologia que une análise profunda de necessidades à tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo desde vigilância especializada até serviços de limpeza, portaria e recepção. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo compromisso com a idoneidade e pelo reconhecimento do mercado como uma empresa ética e moderna.

Cultura e Equipe: Na GSS, acreditamos que nossos profissionais são os alicerces do nosso sucesso. Nossa cultura é fundamentada em quatro pilares essenciais: Respeito, Ética, Qualidade e Proatividade .

Somos defensores da humanização e da inclusão no setor de segurança e serviços. Orgulhamo-nos de adotar iniciativas como a cartilha "Segurança Sem Preconceito", reafirmando nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e livre de discriminação.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você encontrará um ambiente colaborativo, focado em resultados e que valoriza a capacitação constante. Buscamos pessoas que tenham o desejo de crescer junto conosco e que compartilham da nossa paixão por servir com excelência e integridade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Para dar continuidade ao preenchimento da vaga no Gupy para a GSS Segurança e Serviços , aqui está uma estrutura detalhada de responsabilidades e requisitos.

O texto foi elaborado para atrair um perfil que equilibre a capacidade técnica (manuseio de produtos e equipamentos) com a gestão humanizada , alinhada à cultura de ética e respeito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Nesta função, o Supervisor será o responsável por garantir que a excelência operacional da GSS seja percebida diariamente pelo cliente. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Gestão de Equipes: Coordenar escalas de trabalho, controlar a frequência (faltas e substituições) e aplicar feedbacks constantes para manter o engajamento do time de limpeza.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Realizar rondas e inspeções técnicas frequentes nos postos de serviço para garantir que os padrões de higienização e conservação estejam sendo rigorosamente seguidos.
  • Gestão de Insumos: Monitorar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e EPIs, garantindo o uso consciente, a diluição correta de produtos químicos e a solicitação de reposição em tempo hábil.
  • Treinamento Operacional: Capacitar os colaboradores no manuseio de maquinários (enceradeiras, lavadoras de alta pressão, aspiradores industriais) e na aplicação de técnicas de limpeza técnica e hospitalar (se aplicável).
  • Segurança do Trabalho: Fiscalizar o uso obrigatório de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e garantir que todas as normas de segurança (NRs) sejam respeitadas no ambiente de trabalho.
  • Interface com o Cliente: Atender prontamente as solicitações dos contratantes, resolvendo intercorrências operacionais com agilidade e reportando o status dos serviços através de relatórios técnicos.
  • Documentação Operacional: Preencher cronogramas, checklists de limpeza e relatórios de supervisão de forma organizada e digital.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é essencial (Requisitos):

  • Ensino Médio completo (Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Gestão de Facilities, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de supervisão ou liderança operacional no segmento de limpeza e conservação.
  • Conhecimento técnico avançado em produtos químicos (diluição, PH, superfícies) e operação de máquinas de limpeza industrial.
  • Domínio básico/intermediário do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel para controle de estoque e escalas).
  • Possuir CNH ativa (categoria B ou superior) e disponibilidade para deslocamento entre diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Perfil proativo, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de resolução de conflitos.

O que será um diferencial (Desejável):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas de Segurança Patrimonial ou Terceirização de Serviços de Grande Porte.
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança (como NR-35 para trabalho em altura ou NR-06 para EPIs).
  • Residir na região ou ter fácil acesso aos principais eixos de atendimento da empresa.
